ON0A1dsQOV0.text: Qt has a company behind so is more professional, better documentation, better cross platform support, less bugs. This video [VIDEO] is about the reasons Subsurface (a diving app started by Linus Torvalds) changed from GTK to Qt. Things might have improved from GTK I can't tell and also for simpler GUIs GTK might be enough.
